notes.title: V1.6 now live.
notes.content:
Added and changed many backgrounds.
Fixed jumping down from platform, will no longer keep falling if holding down.
Fixed glitch in area 319.

notes.title: V1.5 is now live
notes.content:
Added option to start in default area or a random area when starting a new game.
Some map changes in beginning areas.

This patch may erase any current saved games, will not affect high scores. Map changes will show up on start of new game.

notes.title: Will be adding an option for starting area.
notes.content:
Will add an option to:  a) beam into in a set default starting area or b) a random area.
Game currently picks a random area only. This shouldn't take long to complete.
